trigger: Use when writing, changing or reviewing Markdown documentation for any reader, a repository's own documentation convention included, even when the request is a code change that also updates a documentation page.

includes: the unit of a page and the order of its parts
accuracy of behaviour, status and prerequisites
writing a repository's own documentation convention
excludes: the rules that hold in every repository, such as describing only what is true now
which folder a page goes in, and a site's front matter
files written for one audience under their own standard, such as a developer guide or an agent instruction file
